tweet.text:
Unexpected codex use case: it can control your phone. Plug your phone into your computer. Tell codex "I plugged my phone in."

- delete bloat apps
- organize/back up pictures
- take care of annoying file management (I literally asked it for a certain Pokemon ROM hack and it got it for me)
- navigate apps with intensely buried menu options (looking at you, Instagram)
- clear voicemail inbox
- audit your least used apps for deletion

You can do this with anything you can plug into your computer... I plugged in my Kindle and just asked for books I want. CRAZY way to use these things instead of re-learning ancient and unmaintained UI for old devices
